syllabus_coverage.mathematics: Ex 9.1-9.3 Algebraic Expressions & Identities (multiplication, standard identities (a+b)^2, (a-b)^2, a^2-b^2), Linear Equations in One Variable, Mensuration (trapezium & cylinder)
syllabus_coverage.physical_science: Force & Pressure (P=F/A numerical calculations, broad bag straps, liquid pressure), Friction (rolling vs sliding friction), Chemical Effects of Electric Current

general_instructions: This question paper comprises two sequential parts: PART 1 (Mathematics - 13 Marks) and PART 2 (Physical Science - 12 Marks).
Total duration is 60 minutes. Read all instructions and questions carefully before writing.
The paper consists of 10 mandatory questions categorized into Section A (Objective/AR, 1 Mark), Section B (VSA, 2 Marks), Section C (SA, 3 Marks), and Section D (LA, 5 Marks).
All working, intermediate algebraic steps, balanced chemical explanations, and numerical units must be shown neatly.
Internal choices are provided in Section D of both parts. Tharun must attempt only one of the alternatives where given.

questions.question_text:
A cylindrical metal water tank open at the top has a base radius of $7\text{ m}$ and a height of $10\text{ m}$.
(a) Calculate the curved surface area (CSA) of the cylinder (use $\pi = \frac{22}{7}$). [2]

OR

(a) Using standard identities, factorize completely: $49x^2 - 64y^2$. [2]
(b) Solve the following linear equation for $x$: $\frac{x - 3}{5} + 1 = \frac{2x + 1}{3}$. [3] [5]

questions.subject: Physical Science
questions.question_text: Ball bearings are widely installed between the hub and axle of bicycles and ceiling fan motors. Which of the following statements correctly explains their functional purpose? [1]
options: (a) They replace sliding friction with rolling friction, substantially decreasing frictional resistance.
(b) They increase surface roughness to enhance mechanical grip during high-speed rotation.
(c) They eliminate gravitational force acting on the rotating parts.
(d) They convert rolling friction into fluid friction to lubricate the joint.
questions.correct_answer: (a) They replace sliding friction with rolling friction, substantially decreasing frictional resistance.

questions.subject: Physical Science
questions.question_text:
Given below are two statements labeled Assertion (A) and Reason (R):
Assertion (A): Heavy school bags and backpacks are designed with broad and wide shoulder straps instead of thin cord straps.
Reason (R): For a constant applied load (weight), pressure is inversely proportional to contact area ($P = \frac{F}{A}$); hence, increasing strap surface area reduces pressure on the shoulder.
Select the correct option from the following: [1]
options: (a) Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
(b) Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true but Reason (R) is NOT the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
(c) Assertion (A) is true but Reason (R) is false.
(d) Assertion (A) is false but Reason (R) is true.
questions.correct_answer: (a) Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).

questions.question_text:
(a) Define the process of electroplating. In an electrolytic circuit set up to electroplate copper onto an iron key, identify which electrode (anode or cathode) the iron key should be connected to, and specify the electrolyte solution required. [3]

(b) Why do deep-sea divers wear specially designed reinforced diving suits before venturing deep underwater? State the relationship between liquid pressure, depth, and density. [2] [5]

$b = 42 - 18 = 24\text{ cm}$. Length of other parallel side is $24\text{ cm}$ [0.5 Mark]

solutions.subject: Mathematics
key_steps: (b) $\text{Base Area} = \pi r^2 = \frac{22}{7} \times 7 \times 7 = 154\text{ m}^2$. $\text{Total Sheet Metal Required} = \text{CSA} + \text{Base Area} = 440 + 154 = 594\text{ m}^2$ [1.5 Marks]

solutions.subject: Physical Science
key_steps: Ball bearings convert sliding friction into rolling friction. Rolling friction is much less than sliding friction, minimizing heat and energy loss.

solutions.subject: Physical Science
key_steps: Assertion is true: broad straps reduce shoulder pain. Reason is true: $P = F/A$; increasing contact area decreases pressure. Reason correctly explains Assertion.

solutions.subject: Physical Science
key_steps: Tap water contains dissolved mineral salts that dissociate into free ions to conduct electric current [1 Mark]
Distilled water is free of dissolved salts and ions, making it a poor conductor. Adding common salt (NaCl), an acid, or a base makes it conductive [1 Mark]

solutions.subject: Physical Science
key_steps: (a) $\text{Thrust } F = m \times g = 6\text{ kg} \times 10\text{ m/s}^2 = 60\text{ N}$ [1 Mark]
(b) $\text{Area of contact } A = 0.3\text{ m} \times 0.2\text{ m} = 0.06\text{ m}^2$ [1 Mark]

solutions.subject: Physical Science
key_steps: (a) Definition: Electroplating is the process of depositing a layer of any desired metal on another material by means of electricity [1 Mark]. Iron key connected to negative terminal (cathode) [1 Mark]. Copper plate at anode, copper sulphate solution (CuSO4) as electrolyte [1 Mark].
(b) Pressure increases with depth: deeper holes in a plastic bottle squirt water much farther out; pressure gauge/manometer shows higher liquid column difference at greater depth [2 Marks].

(a) Distinction: Sliding friction occurs when one surface slides over another (e.g., sliding a heavy box on the floor); rolling friction occurs when an object rolls over a surface (e.g., luggage roller wheels) [1.5 Marks]. Contact area and surface interlocking during rolling is momentary and extremely small compared to continuous sliding [1.5 Marks].

(b) Hydrostatic pressure increases with depth ($P = h \rho g$). At $15\text{ m}$, the column of water exerts immense compressive force, requiring rigid reinforced diving suits to prevent bodily injury [2 Marks].
